CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.d11b_preview_soak_scheduler_token_valid_v1(p_token text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'vault'
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1
    from vault.decrypted_secrets s
    where s.name='d11b_preview_soak_scheduler_token'
      and s.decrypted_secret=p_token
  );
$function$
